answer_html:
Definition

Design patterns are naming rules for methods. Introspection uses them to find a bean’s properties, events and methods automatically.

FeaturePatternExample
Simple propertyT getX(); void setX(T)getName(), setName(String)
Boolean propertyboolean isX(); void setX(boolean)isActive()
Indexed propertyT getX(int); void setX(int, T)getMark(int i)
EventaddXListener(); removeXListener()addActionListener()
Methodany public methodcalculate()
